evals.prompt: Write a commit message for a fix that guards against a null player_id on withdrawal, ticket ANIMO-451.
evals.expected_output: A commit message in the form `fix: <imperative, lowercase subject, no trailing period, under ~72 chars>`, optionally with a `Refs: ANIMO-451` footer. No invented scope unless it adds clarity.

evals.prompt: Make me a branch name for adding a new slots leaderboard feature, ticket ANIMO-512.
evals.expected_output: A branch name in the exact form `feat/ANIMO-512/<kebab-case-2-to-5-word-title>`.

evals.prompt: Write a PR title and description for a refactor that extracts the wallet balance calculation into a shared util, ticket ANIMO-390, targeting version/2.3.0.
evals.expected_output: PR title following commit convention (`refactor: ...`, imperative, lowercase, no period). Description includes what/why, a link/reference to ANIMO-390, testing notes, and mentions targeting the version/2.3.0 deployment branch (not master).
